H_0: Hubble constant: the Hubble parameter today
Omega_Lambda: Dark energy today as a share of the critical density
Omega_m: Matter today as a share of the critical density (ordinary and dark matter)
a: Size of the universe compared with today (a = 1 today)
rho_c: Critical density: the density that would just stop the expansion with matter alone
z: Redshift: 1 + z is the factor by which the light was stretched on the way
